effect.name: Bend (Switch)
effect.description: (This effect is an attempt to recreate Squeeze from the Alight Motion) Bends the texture so that it follows the arc of a circle.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Bend (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.30 */
parameter.description: (This effect is an attempt to recreate Squeeze from the Alight Motion) Bends the texture so that it follows the arc of a circle.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines which color will be the basis for modification. Set to 0 means it will be the texture of the object and set to 1 it will be the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Angle
parameter.description: This variable defines the angle of curvature (recommended range: -90* to 90*)

parameter.name: Start
parameter.description: This variable determines where the bend should start.

parameter.name: Tune Head
parameter.description: This variable defines the bend at the end of the texture opposite the points.

parameter.name: Tune Tail
parameter.description: This variable limits the bend at the points.

parameter.name: Position X
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the texture in the X axis.

parameter.name: Position Y
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the texture in the Y axis.
